rationale: The prompt's central requirement is bilingual scanned-page OCR with position and confidence metadata. The anchored # Visual Hierarchy scopes the source-visible material to Diagnoses and fixes visual hierarchy in a page, screen, or layout using ranked levers - size, weight, color, position, whitespace - and the one-focal-point-per-view rule. Use when someone asks "why does this layout feel, which does not provide a plausible route to that central input/output boundary.
